name: mix a word state by repeated add-rotate-XOR rounds with injected key words
mechanism: load key, nonce, counter and constants into a small array of machine words; repeat rounds that only add words, rotate words by fixed amounts and XOR words together (in a quarter-round pattern across rows then columns); add the initial state back at the end; the output serves as a keystream block, a block cipher, or a keyed compression depending on how it is wrapped

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Salsa20' in section Computer science / Cryptography:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'ChaCha20 updated variant of Salsa20':

requires: word addition, rotation and XOR only (no tables)
fails_when: rotation constants and round count are the whole design; too few rounds are distinguishable
